entries.prompt: Re-extract/correct ONLY the rigid mask of official PHG2019preview photo04 using the FIRST photo as PRIMARY camera/projection authority. SECOND isolated A1 is useful for visible structural identity but projects the helmet too tall,narrow and bombed compared with FIRST. Match the ACTUAL FIRST source pose/projection: broad swept brim,upper open framework projected LOWER/FLATTER,and a SHORTER projected brim-to-chin span. Keep the source oblique upward-inclined view and its precise roll/yaw,not a new frontal view. Do not physically redesign the mask or stretch it generically; faithfully reproduce how its same rigid structures project in FIRST. Preserve the same whole broad rim silhouette and asymmetric widths,existing angular crown framework/apertures,opaque dark optic slit,the actual single prominent red temple point visible in this view,diagonal cheek slats and the exact central nose/jaw connections. Do not add a hidden lens triangle or opposite module. Keep the nose's physical details/source joins,just match its observed camera projection and source compact silhouette. Do not make the open crown a tall dome or increase hidden depth. No new bars,holes,vents,runes,glyphs,ornaments or speculative microdetail. Fine exact dimensions remain limited by source100–150pixels; use FIRST visual proportions rather than forcing an arbitrary numeric ratio. Exclude ALL biological skin,teeth/mandibles below the metal boundary,dreadlocks/hair rings,neck,body/armor,the raised hand and held disk above/right,and all background. Preserve source actual metal palette/local light; no invented paint. Exactly one complete isolated rigid mask,genuine transparent RGBA,actual empty crown apertures transparent,physically opaque dark optics remain opaque. Center complete silhouette with10percent clear transparent margin all sides,longest axis78-80percent canvas,brim/crown/chin unclipped,no floor/shadow plane/scene/UI/text. Source-numbered PREVIEW2019study only,no inferred class/cosmetic or final-retail status. Only restore actual source camera/projection; do not reconstruct hidden geometry.

selfReview.kind: Agent review of native ImageGen output and original source; not human art validation.
selfReview.observations: The distinctive broad swept horizontal brow/crown rim and its raised geometric open/lattice crown structure must remain with their actual source outline; lower face has source triangular/angular openings and inset patterns. Preserve every coarse visible opening and panel as shown,without inventing full hidden mesh. Source head is tilted upward and turned slightly toward image-right; keep exact projected silhouette. Exclude the raised organic hand and separate thrown disk above/right of the head,including any disk/hardware that is not attached to the mask. Preserve only actually visible small physical red lens point(s) under the brow at image-left; do not infer an unseen triangle or a second module.
selfReview.exclusions: All wearer biology,hair/dreads,hair rings,neck,body/armor,weapons,held hand/disk and scene.
selfReview.limits: Visible source-view geometry only; fine relief and unclear attachment ownership remain qualified.
selfReview.sourceProjectionCheck: A2 compact source-camera projection passed independent preflight; B retains the corrected low cage/broad brim,one actual red physical point and transparent crown apertures. No class identity inferred.
